prompt_text: I need a dental implant in Phoenix. Which specific dental practices should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I just need one quick thing first.

I don’t have live internet access in this chat, so I can’t pull current phone numbers or confirm business hours. If you want me to produce a specific list of practices to call in Phoenix, tell me:
- the ZIP code or neighborhood you’re in or willing to travel to
- whether you have dental insurance (and the plan), or if you’re paying out‑of‑pocket
- whether this is a single implant, several implants, or a full‑arch/all‑on‑4 type case
- if you prefer a particular clinician type (oral surgeon, periodontist, prosthodontist) or need sedation

If you’d rather I don’t need those details, I can instead give:
- the exact questions to ask any clinic when you call,
- the types of specialists to call (and why),
- criteria to pick the best practice near you,
- a suggested script to leave or say on a call.

Which would you prefer?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
